newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwandan national assembly elects new speaker.
newsitem.headline: Rwandan national assembly elects new speaker.

text.p: Rwanda's Transitional National Assembly has elected a new speaker after dismissing the previous speaker for incompetence, state Rwandan radio said on Friday.
Monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, it said parliament elected Joseph Sebarenzi as speaker with 47 votes against 22 for Aaron Makuba and seven new deputies were sworn in on Friday.
The previous speaker, Juvenal Nkusi, who had held the post for 26 months, was dismissed in February for incompetence.
